About · Press

Quoting a review fairly

  • Give the "reviewed as of" date. A review is a reading at that date.
  • Quote counts with their coverage: "11 of 38 items reviewed so far hold", not "11 hold".
  • Do not turn counts into a score, a percentage, or a ranking. Norantz does not grade governments or reports.
  • Link to the fixed version you quote, so readers see what you saw.

Logos

The Norantz lockup, mark, and wordmark, for light and dark backgrounds.

By Plural Futures

Norantz (Basque for “towards where?”) is a second reading of national futures, by Plural Futures. It reads each report on its own terms, describes rather than grades, and shows its sources, coverage, and method on every page.

Reviews on this site are drafted with generative AI and may contain errors. Read them as a conversation starter and a starting point for deeper, human-led analysis.

Read generously. Check rigorously.
